WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
c_cols AS (
    SELECT r.`raceId`, r.`time` AS `champion_time`, 
           l.`time` AS `last_driver_time`
    FROM results AS r
    INNER JOIN lapTimes AS l ON r.`raceId` = l.`raceId` AND r.`driverId` = l.`driverId`
    WHERE r.`position` = 1 AND l.`position` = 1
    AND r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
),
c_rows AS (
    SELECT raceId, champion_time, last_driver_time
    FROM c_cols
    WHERE champion_time IS NOT NULL AND last_driver_time IS NOT NULL
),
t_calculate AS (
    SELECT raceId, 
           champion_time, 
           last_driver_time,
           (CAST(strftime('%S', last_driver_time) || '.' || substr(last_driver_time, instr(last_driver_time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) - 
            CAST(strftime('%S', champion_time) || '.' || substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, '.') + 1) AS REAL)) * 100.0 / 
           CAST(strftime('%S', last_driver_time) || '.' || substr(last_driver_time, instr(last_driver_time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) AS percentage_difference
    FROM c_rows
)
SELECT percentage_difference
FROM t_calculate
WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info);
